claim: Let's try listing all the AUs for fanfiction there are! - Reddit
summary: Inferno Squad is the main characters from the Battlefront II campaign (an elite Imperial Special Forces team), but a lot of the canon content on them comes from the Christie Golden (canon) Inferno Squad novel. Even if you're not interested in the game, the novel is pretty great so I highly recommend it. There's a grand total of ~15 fics for these characters on AO3, so I started writing my own ...
